$comment: Closed vocabularies every SDK spells identically. `pnpm gen:constants` generates one constant group per enum in every SDK (tools/gen-sdk-constants.ts). These are the CANONICAL values. Pack types (P4-21), patch strategies and transports (P4-04) come from plans/P4-01.md; bindings are added when their owner defines them. The outlet and update vocabularies are plans/P3-01.md §2.8's tables, in their order, and equal the constants in `@polaris-key/protocol/distribution` and `/update` (a reserved value such as `packs` joins an enum only with its own plan-mode package). The version schemes are not an enum: `semver+build` and `4part` are not identifiers.

enums.name: platform
enums.description: OS family, the canonical `X-PKey-Platform` value (README §3.1). iPadOS is `ios`.

enums.name: arch
enums.description: CPU architecture, the canonical `X-PKey-Arch` value (README §3.1). `universal` and `any` are artifact values, not header values, and are not listed.

enums.name: sdkId
enums.description: The canonical X-PKey-SDK value (WIRE-CONTRACT-V3 §5.2): which SDK made the request. The SDK's version is X-PKey-SDK-Version. An SDK adds its id when it lands.

enums.name: storeBackend
enums.description: Where a token store keeps the token, the `backend` of `Store.status()` (P1b-09). Mirrors `STORE_BACKENDS` in `@polaris-key/client-core/store`; a test keeps them equal.

enums.name: storeDegradedReason
enums.description: Why a token store is weaker than its platform's best option, the `degraded.reason` of `Store.status()` (P1b-09). Mirrors `STORE_DEGRADED_REASONS` in `@polaris-key/client-core/store`; a test keeps them equal.

enums.name: outletKind
enums.description: The 17 outlet kinds, in `OUTLET_KINDS` order (README §3.1, plans/P3-01.md §2.9). `unknown` is a detection result, not a kind, and is not listed.

enums.name: outletConfidence
enums.description: How sure outlet detection is, strongest first (`OUTLET_CONFIDENCES`, plans/P3-01.md §2.9).

enums.name: outletSubkind
enums.description: How a `direct` install was put on the device, where that changes who updates it (`OUTLET_SUBKINDS`, plans/P3-01.md §2.9).

enums.name: updateAction
enums.description: The update decision's action (`UPDATE_ACTIONS`, plans/P3-01.md §2.8; `packs` added by plans/P4-13.md §2.6).

enums.name: updateNoneReason
enums.description: Why the update decision is `none` (`NONE_REASONS`, plans/P3-01.md §2.8).

enums.name: updateBlockedReason
enums.description: Why the update decision is `blocked` (`BLOCKED_REASONS`, plans/P3-01.md §2.8; `content-floor` and `revoked-content` added by plans/P4-13.md §2.6).

enums.name: binaryMethod
enums.description: How a `binary` decision installs the new build (`BINARY_METHODS`, plans/P3-01.md §2.8).

enums.name: updateEvent
enums.description: The update telemetry event names on the unsigned `devices/report` (plans/P3-01.md §2.10). The shapes and the Worker allowlist are P6-03's.

enums.name: packType
enums.description: The pack types a v1 SDK can hold (`PACK_TYPES`, plans/P4-01.md §2.2): `files.tree` everywhere, `godot.pck` in Godot. A record may name any `PACK_TYPE_PATTERN` type; an unknown one makes the pack unusable (`pack-type-unsupported`).

enums.name: packDelivery
enums.description: An app record's `content.expects[].delivery` (`PACK_DELIVERIES`, plans/P4-01.md §2.4). Any other `VOCAB_TOKEN_PATTERN` value is read as `on-demand`.

enums.name: packActivation
enums.description: A pack record's `handler.activation` (`PACK_ACTIVATIONS`, plans/P4-01.md §2.3). An unknown value makes the pack unusable.

enums.name: filesLayout
enums.description: A pack variant's `files.layout` (`FILES_LAYOUTS`, plans/P4-01.md §2.3): a single-file payload with offsets and gaps, or a directory of files. An unknown layout makes the variant unusable.

enums.name: contentCodec
enums.description: An object ref's `codec` (`CONTENT_CODECS`, plans/P4-01.md §2.3): one zstd frame with its content size, or stored raw (`bytes === size`). An unknown codec makes that object unusable.

enums.name: patchMethod
enums.description: A pack delta's `method` v1 applies (`PATCH_METHODS`, plans/P4-01.md §2.3). `godot-delta-pck`, `hdiffpatch` and `bsdiff` are reserved and not listed; an unknown method makes the delta infeasible.

enums.name: patchScope
enums.description: A pack delta's `scope` (`PATCH_SCOPES`, plans/P4-01.md §2.3): the whole payload, or the per-entry set. A delta of another scope is dropped.

enums.name: variantAxis
enums.description: The variant axis names a v1 manifest may declare (`VARIANT_AXES`, plans/P4-01.md §2.2). A record may name any `VARIANT_AXIS_PATTERN` axis; a variant on an axis the host has no preferences for is ineligible.

enums.name: patchStrategy
enums.description: The install planner's strategies (plans/P4-01.md §2.9, A7 §4.2): a plan result's `strategy` and a host's `caps.strategies`. `plan-matrix.json` pins them.

enums.name: transport
enums.description: How a deliverable's bytes arrive (`TRANSPORTS` in `@polaris-key/manifest`, P2b-02; README §3.1): the planner's `caps.transports` and a platform target's `transport` (plans/P4-01.md §2.9).

enums.name: delegablePackType
enums.description: The pack types a delegated content key may sign (`DELEGABLE_PACK_TYPES`, plans/P4-19.md §2.5, decision 5). A delegation's `types` outside this list are ignored; `godot.pck`, `godot.zip`, `audio.bank`, `ml.model` and `custom.*` are never delegable. `delegationCases` pins them.

enums.name: dataOnlyExtension
enums.description: The file extensions a delegated install may hold (`DATA_ONLY_EXTENSIONS`, plans/P4-19.md §2.5 rule 2): the final segment's text after its last `.`, ASCII-lowercased. An allow-list: anything else is refused (`pack-not-data-only`, rule `extension`). `dataOnlyCases` pins them.
